audit_observations: Independent audit of both halves plus enlarged cancelled line, cancelled quantifier, and overwritten integer symbol. The cancelled sign after pour is more like the recurring universal glyph than two letters tt, but both remain recorded. X/Y in the first global class, unclosed bracket/parenthesis, supports family note, and closing C étant complète are retained literally.
